DPP-4 Inhibitors 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-752241  
Guideline Name 
DPP-4 Inhibitors  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:alogliptin, alogliptin/metformin, alogliptin/pioglitazone, Brand Janumet, Brand 
Janumet XR, Brand Januvia, Jentadueto, Tradjenta  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient has a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 460 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 460 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 History of failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams daily for 90 days  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Contraindication or intolerance to metformin  
 
AND 
 
3 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a GLP-1 
receptor agonist or combination agent [e.g., Victoza (liraglutide), Byetta (exenatide), Xultophy 
(insulin degludec-liraglutide)], or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use  
 
Product Name:Brynovin, Jentadueto XR, saxagliptin/metformin ER, Brand Onglyza, generic 
saxagliptin, Zituvio, Sitagliptin, Zituvimet, Sitagliptin/metformin, Zituvimet XR, 
Sitagliptin/metformin ER, generic sitagliptin phosphate, generic sitagliptin 
phosphate/metformin, generic sitagliptin phosphate/metformin ER  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient has a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus  
 
AND 
 
2 - ONE of the following:  
 
 2.1 History of failure to metformin at a minimum dose of 1500 milligrams daily for 90 days  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Contraindication or intolerance to metformin

UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines

AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 History of failure for 90 days to THREE of the following:  
• 
alogliptin, alogliptin-metformin, or alogliptin-pioglitazone  
• 
Brand Januvia  
• 
Brand Janumet/Janumet XR  
• 
Jentadueto  
• 
Tradjenta  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 Intolerance or contraindication to THREE of the following:  
• 
alogliptin, alogliptin-metformin, or alogliptin-pioglitazone  
• 
Brand Januvia  
• 
Brand Janumet/Janumet XR  
• 
Jentadueto  
• 
Tradjenta  
 
AND 
 
4 - Provider attests that the requested medication will not be used concurrently with a GLP-1 
receptor agonist or combination agent [e.g., Victoza (liraglutide), Byetta (exenatide), Xultophy 
(insulin degludec-liraglutide)], or a plan has been developed to address concomitant use
